Name: # header. build.py generate writes build/SLUS_210.75.recomp.elf with these section headers for ps2_recomp only (program
# headers and every loaded byte unchanged); the runtime loads the disc's own ELF. Rows must tile the PT_LOAD segment
# 0x00100000-0x01992000 in order. Kinds: code = EE code (SHF_EXECINSTR); vu = VU microcode (.vutext*
# but skipped by ps2_recomp's isExecutableSection); data/rodata = not code; ctors = the MW constructor table
# (ps2_recomp makes each entry a correctness-critical start); bss = NOBITS.
.text
Kind: code             # crt0 + game (MW) + SDK 3.0.2 + CRI; ends with the this-adjusting thunks

Name: .vutext
Kind: vu             # 45 VIF DMA tags walk exactly to 0x3AC780; 33 MPG words

Name: .rodata.cdvdman_irx
Kind: rodata  # an embedded IOP IRX image (ELF e_type 0xFF80)

Name: .ctors
Kind: ctors           # Sinit_Table: 143 entries + the 0 terminator at 0x46969C

Name: .bss
Kind: bss               # PT_LOAD memsz beyond filesz; gp 0x004828F0 (.reginfo)
